entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Uh, it appears we have time for on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh, it appears we have time for one last question."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""President Rayne, given this countr..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne, given this country's rather turbulent political history..."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Will you accept the results of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will you accept the results of the election, whatever they are?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What kind of a question is that? O..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of a question is that? Of course I'll accept the results."
entries.menuText: "What kind of a question is that? Of course I'll accept the results."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will respect what the people of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will respect what the people of Sordland decide."
entries.menuText: "I will respect what the people of Sordland decide."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I accepted the results when the US..."
entries.dialogueText: "I accepted the results when the USP voted me out, didn't I?"
entries.menuText: "I accepted the results when the USP voted me out, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. But I pledge I will never sto..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. But I pledge I will never stop fighting for my beliefs."
entries.menuText: "Yes. But I pledge I will never stop fighting for my beliefs."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Ha! Listen to this man.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Listen to this man."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""You're going to trust someone who..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to trust someone who promised change, only to warp the constitution to suit his own desires?"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""You're going to trust someone who..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to trust someone who promised change, only to attempt to warp the constitution to suit his own desires?"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""You're going to trust someone who..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to trust someone who fabricated an emergency as an excuse to seize power?"

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Mr. Stahler, my question was for t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Stahler, my question was for the President alone. Please don't interrupt."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis looked like he wanted to say..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis looked like he wanted to say something, but thought better of it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun looked like he wanted to sa..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun looked like he wanted to say something, but thought better of it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manoly looked like she wanted to sa..."
entries.dialogueText: Manoly looked like she wanted to say something, but thought better of it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens looked like he wanted to say..."
entries.dialogueText: Frens looked like he wanted to say something, but thought better of it.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""The mere fact that you have to ask..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mere fact that you have to ask that question is proof that Sordland is far from the democracy it must become."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""The mere fact that you have to ask..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mere fact that you have to ask that question is proof that Sordland is far from the democracy it must become."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Right. I'd like to end the evening..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. I'd like to end the evening by allowing each candidate to make a short closing statement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis looked at the floor."
entries.dialogueText: Denis looked at the floor.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""This is such a disrespectful quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is such a disrespectful question to ask a sitting president. The leader of Sordland shall stay in power for however long its people and God will."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I couldn't have said that better m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't have said that better myself."
entries.menuText: "I couldn't have said that better myself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And that's the reason I left the U..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that's the reason I left the USP."
entries.menuText: "And that's the reason I left the USP."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Surely this is a disrespectful que..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely this is a disrespectful question to ask a sitting president. The leader of Sordland shall stay in power for however long its people and God will."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""How dare you ask that of a sitting..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you ask that of a sitting president? The leader of Sordland shall stay in power for however long is the Sords and God wills it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If there is a God, you will never..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there is a God, you will never become president."
entries.menuText: "If there is a God, you will never become president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""She was well within her right to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was well within her right to ask that. The president must never be elevated above anyone else."
entries.menuText: "She was well within her right to ask that. The president must never be elevated above anyone else."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""No further comment. The events of..."
entries.dialogueText: "No further comment. The events of this evening speak for themselves."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I agree. No further comment.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. No further comment."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I have nothing to add. I trust the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have nothing to add. I trust the Sordish people will make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""I have nothing to add. I trust the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have nothing to add. I trust the Sordish people will make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "Mansoun looked at Denis' empty chai..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun looked at Denis' empty chair.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I won't comment further. The event..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't comment further. The events of this evening speak for themselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens looked at Denis and Mansoun's..."
entries.dialogueText: Frens looked at Denis and Mansoun's empty chairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manoly looked at Denis and Mansoun'..."
entries.dialogueText: Manoly looked at Denis and Mansoun's empty chairs.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Well, I will say something.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I will say something."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""People of Sordland, I have watched..."
entries.dialogueText: "People of Sordland, I have watched this man lead our great country astray. Place your trust in me, and I will put us back on the path that the Lord chose for us."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Whatever differences of opinion Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever differences of opinion President Rayne and I expressed during this debate, the NFP is prepared to stand with him and his party. For a Sordland that truly belongs to the Sords."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""For a Sordland that truly belongs..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a Sordland that truly belongs to its own people, there is only one way to vote."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I am a man of action, not of words.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am a man of action, not of words."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Vote NFP. For a Sordland that trul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vote NFP. For a Sordland that truly belongs to the Sords. We shall realise our destiny as a great people."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""President Rayne?""
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne?"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I am grateful to the President for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful to the President for finally paving the way for my party into Assembly. But I ask you: Why stop there? Sordish Socialism is upon our doorstep. All that is left to do is embrace it."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""My party spent years shut out of a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My party spent years shut out of assembly while the voices of thousands of Sords were denied. It is time for a new way forward. The People's Front is the future Sordland deserves."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Join our coalition and we promise..."
entries.dialogueText: "Join our coalition and we promise equality for every man and woman, every Blud and Sord."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Now that smaller parties have been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that smaller parties have been given a voice, it is time to rise up and make your own heard. Man or woman, Blud or Sord."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I know Sordland is ready for democ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know Sordland is ready for democracy. Under the PFJP, you will enjoy a freedom you have never known before."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""My predecessor Frens Ricter believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "My predecessor Frens Ricter believed that Sordland was finally ready for democracy. It's time for the people to prove him right."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've already said everything I nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already said everything I need to say. Thank you for a pleasant evening."
entries.menuText: "I've already said everything I need to say. Thank you for a pleasant evening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why accept my opponents' mediocre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why accept my opponents' mediocre promises when you could have... the moon?"
entries.menuText: "Why accept my opponents' mediocre promises when you could have... the moon?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""People of Sordland... we have only..."
entries.dialogueText: "People of Sordland... we have only just begun."
entries.menuText: "People of Sordland... we have only just begun."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A new day began to dawn. We must n..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new day began to dawn. We must not abandon what we started."
entries.menuText: "A new day began to dawn. We must not abandon what we started."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Very well. Thanks to all the candi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Thanks to all the candidates for your time tonight. The Sordish Broadcasting Corporation wishes all our viewers a good evening."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She motioned to the crew, and the c..."
entries.dialogueText: She motioned to the crew, and the cameras stopped rolling.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Whatever differences President Ray..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever differences President Rayne and I expressed during this debate, our alliance still stands. No matter who wins, we will govern together to bring Sordland a freedom it has never known before."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand your concerns given m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your concerns given my predecessors' attempts to cling to power. But I swear I will serve only as long as the people want me."
entries.menuText: "I understand your concerns given my predecessors' attempts to cling to power. But I swear I will serve only as long as the people want me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course, there's always the poss..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, there's always the possibility of election fraud, in which case I will fight to make sure the will of the people is respected."
entries.menuText: "Of course, there's always the possibility of election fraud, in which case I will fight to make sure the will of the people is respected."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""Um...with those who remain at leas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Um...with those who remain at least."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Denis, calm down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Denis, calm down."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""No. The charade has gone on long e..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. The charade has gone on long enough. How can the blatant censorship of the media go unremarked upon on this stage?"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Gladly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moderator took a minute to rega..."
entries.dialogueText: The moderator took a minute to regain her composure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis rose from his seat."
entries.dialogueText: Denis rose from his seat.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Admiration? You had me thrown in p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admiration? You had me thrown in prison!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Denis, I have nothing but admirati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Denis, I have nothing but admiration for you and your ideology. Please do not test my goodwill."
entries.menuText: "Denis, I have nothing but admiration for you and your ideology. Please do not test my goodwill."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Unbelievable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Unbelievable."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""This charade has gone on long enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "This charade has gone on long enough. Can't you others see he has the media rigged against us?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't make me do it again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't make me do it again."
entries.menuText: "Don't make me do it again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't give that order.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't give that order."
entries.menuText: "I didn't give that order."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Not to mention the disappearance o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention the disappearance of one of the most prominent opposition leaders."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Not to mention the disappearance o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention the disappearance of one of the most prominent opposition parties."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Let's go, Mansoun.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go, Mansoun."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""To say nothing of the mysterious d..."
entries.dialogueText: "To say nothing of the mysterious deaths of certain individuals in the President's orbit..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Leave this building. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave this building. Now."
entries.menuText: "Leave this building. Now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The studio went deathly silent."
entries.dialogueText: The studio went deathly silent.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Stahler. If I really am as pow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Stahler. If I really am as powerful as you claim, wouldn't it be extremely foolish of you to speak against me?"
entries.menuText: "Mr. Stahler. If I really am as powerful as you claim, wouldn't it be extremely foolish of you to speak against me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sit back down. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sit back down. Now."
entries.menuText: "Sit back down. Now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and do not ever show your face in front of me again."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Stahler. Leave this stage and do not ever show your face in front of me again."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I'll find my own way out.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll find my own way out."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""The hell you do.""
entries.dialogueText: "The hell you do."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have no idea what you're talking..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea what you're talking about."
entries.menuText: "I have no idea what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Abdicating responsibility. A good..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicating responsibility. A good look for a President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If I was censoring the media, woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I was censoring the media, would I permit you to make this kind of scene?"
entries.menuText: "If I was censoring the media, would I permit you to make this kind of scene?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Whatever you think you know about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you think you know about me, it's a lie."
entries.menuText: "Whatever you think you know about me, it's a lie."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis gaped at me indignantly, then..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis gaped at me indignantly, then sat, his face red.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Guards, this man is a danger to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guards, this man is a danger to me. Please escort him out of the building at once."
entries.menuText: "Guards, this man is a danger to me. Please escort him out of the building at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis sat, his face red. None of th..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis sat, his face red. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis paled slightly."
entries.dialogueText: Denis paled slightly.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I won't play this game a second lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't play this game a second longer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Denis walked out of the stud..."
entries.dialogueText: He and Denis walked out of the studio. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""They're more violent than they use..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're more violent than they used to be, I'll agree with you there. But your reaction crossed a line."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Red Youth were out of control...."
entries.dialogueText: "The Red Youth were out of control. You should have done something."
entries.menuText: "The Red Youth were out of control. You should have done something."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""It doesn't have to be this way. Vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't have to be this way. Vote People's Front for real change in '57."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""I cannot fucking believe this!""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot fucking believe this!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Denis loudly pushed his chair back..."
entries.dialogueText: Denis loudly pushed his chair back and stormed out of the studio. None of the other candidates spoke.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Let's just get this dog and pony s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just get this dog and pony show over with."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Sorry, Denis, I can't risk it. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Denis, I can't risk it. You're on your own."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun got up and looked into the..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun got up and looked into the camera.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""You claimed to understand the plig..."
entries.dialogueText: "You claimed to understand the plight of the common man back in Narbel. But it was all an act, wasn't it, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Ever since our confrontation in Na..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ever since our confrontation in Narbel I've known exactly what kind of man you were, Mr. President."
